programme.title: Paradise Hotel

programme.title: Lyxfällan: Avsnitt 2401
programme.desc: I premiäravsnittet av nya Lyxfällan träffar vi före detta Big Brother-stjärnan Hanna Widerstedt, 26, som lever lyxliv i Berlin trots en inkomst på kring 3000 kronor i månaden.

programme.title: Lyxfällan: Avsnitt 2403
programme.desc: Fredrik, 28, bor i Bollnäs tillsammans med sin flickvän. Han slösar enorma summor pengar på skräpmat, tobak – och framför allt på spel.

programme.title: Lyxfällan: Avsnitt 2303
programme.desc: Paret Victor, 25, och Elin, 21, är totalt olika när det kommer till ekonomi – han vill helst spendera så mycket som möjligt medan hon vill ha full koll. Elin jobbar dubbelt medan Victor hänger hemma.

programme.title: Lyxfällan: Avsnitt 2402
programme.desc: Tvåbarnspappan Magnus, 38, älskar att shoppa bilar och prylar – och hans radhus strax utanför Stockholm är proppfyllt av dyra teknikgrejer. Allt är finansierat av lån med skyhöga räntor.

programme.title: Lyxfällan: Avsnitt 2605
programme.desc: Jennie från Bollnäs drömmer om ett hus på landet och en stabil tillvaro till sig och sina två barn. Men trots att hon är arbetslös spenderar hon stora summor på skräpmat och onödig shopping.

programme.title: Lyxfällan: Avsnitt 3403
programme.desc: Kim drömmer om att tillbringa mer tid med sina barn och att kunna erbjuda resor och ett hem där de kan ha egna rum. Men betalningsanmärkningarna och skuldberget gör det omöjligt.

programme.title: Unga Mammor: Avsnitt 107
programme.desc: 16-åriga Madde har äntligen blivit mamma. Mileah har kommit till världen och vid en första anblick har allting gått bra.

programme.title: Unga Mammor: Avsnitt 108
programme.desc: Madde och Isaacs bebis tillbringar sina första dagar i livet på sjukhuset. Hon fick andningssvårigheter efter förlossningen på grund av fostervatten i lungorna.

programme.title: Unga Mammor: Avsnitt 109
programme.desc: Natalies kennel har blivit granskad av SKK och nu måste hon vidta en rad åtgärder. Om hon inte gör det så kommer de stänga ner kenneln innan veckan är slut. Men hon har ett tugnt jobb framför sig.

programme.title: Unga Mammor: Avsnitt 501
programme.desc: I säsongspremiären av Unga mammor får du återigen träffa Natalie som nu flyttat till ny gård utanför Herrljunga med Richard och sina tre barn. Fayme som var med i säsong 3 kommer tillbaka.

programme.title: Unga Mammor: Avsnitt 502
programme.desc: 23-åriga Ellinor är ny för säsongen och bor tillsammans med sin man Jimmy utanför Stockholm. De har precis fått en son som de ska namnge men har svårt att bestämma sig för namn.

programme.title: Unga Mammor: Avsnitt 503
programme.desc: Luma tar hem en inredare för att få ordning på uterummet. Niffi ska åka och handla med sina tvillingar och Sonia ska gå till BVC med sin äldsta dotter Daisy.

programme.title: Unga Mammor: Avsnitt 504
programme.desc: Ellinor ska in till stan med sin son Aaron för att spela in en babypodd, och det blir första gången hon jobbar med honom som sällskap. Hur ska det gå?

programme.title: Unga Mammor: Avsnitt 505
programme.desc: Luma tar med sina tre barn för att köpa pizza. Barnen låser in sig i bilen och Luma vet inte hur hon ska lösa det. Sonia och Liam tar barnen på utflykt för att lära dem att åka skateboard.

programme.title: Unga Mammor: Avsnitt 506
programme.desc: Fayme ska måla staketet på tomten tillsammans med hela familjen, men hur ska det gå med tre små barn?

programme.title: Unga Mammor: Avsnitt 507
programme.desc: Det är dags för Fayme att ta med barnen till leklandet. Natalie åker och köper tapeter till Ronjas nya rum och Jonatan ska lära Niffi att laga mat.

programme.title: Unga Mammor: Avsnitt 508
programme.desc: Ellinor, Jimmy och deras son Aaron ska på par middag hos Ellinors väninna Kissie som är lite pedant i sitt hem.

programme.title: Frusna vägar
programme.desc: Kent måste bärga en skoter som blivit så skadad att den nästan gått itu. Dennis försöker hjälpa en dansk förare som fastnat i en backe – men stöter på patrull när föraren försöker styra bärgningen.

programme.title: Frusna vägar
programme.desc: Christer och praktikanten Kim ska försöka få liv i en lastbil på E4:an vars motor har skurit. Katarina måste försöka komma in i en elbil vars batteri är så urladdat att låset är ur funktion.

programme.title: Frusna vägar
programme.desc: En 70 tons-trailer med en stor grävskopa har havererat i en uppförsbacke, och Lill-Stefan rycker ut. Katarina får larm om en bil som fått punktering på en särskilt farlig väg där hastigheten är hög.

programme.title: Frusna vägar
programme.desc: Att vara säker på vägen är prio när Christer i Örnsköldsvik tvingas jobba på E4:an mitt i rusningstrafik. Stefan har inte problem med trafiken, men däremot med att flytta ett helt hus.

programme.title: Frusna vägar
programme.desc: Snöstorm, kaos och en lång natt är verkligheten i Örnsköldsvik där lastbil efter lastbil kör fast på en igensnöad E4:a. Kents utmaningar består av att kommunicera med turister som kört fast i Åre.

programme.title: 48 Hours: Scared to Death

programme.title: 48 Hours: Terror at the Morgue

programme.title: 48 Hours: A Question of Murder

programme.title: 48 Hours: Texas Confidential

programme.title: 48 Hours

programme.title: COPS: I Always pay my Debts

programme.title: COPS
programme.desc: A man who ran from police complains that he was not read his rights. Officers detain kids who threw rocks at windowfronts. A paranoid man claims he is being chased by drug dealers.

programme.title: COPS
programme.desc: Police conduct a high-speed chase on a car with a missing tire. Police respond to a tow truck driver being assaulted. Police are called when a relative attacks a woman's husband.

programme.desc: The body of Nathalie Villermet, 46, manager of a small hotel and -restaurant, is found by a walker in the woods outside Paris, hidden under branches.

programme.title: Norska Fall: Avsnitt 203
programme.desc: Den före detta dansaren Julio Kopseng anklagas för våldtäkt 2013. Han döms senare för att ha förgripit sig på 19 kvinnor, däribland sin före detta flickvän. Varför tog det så lång tid att fånga honom?

programme.title: Svenska fall: Avsnitt 606
programme.desc: Sista gången Fatima Berggren sågs vid liv var på hennes 57-årsdag i maj 2017. Ärendet betraktas först som en kidnappning, men polisen inser snart att det handlar om mord.

programme.title: Svenska fall: Avsnitt 503
programme.desc: En fastighetsägare gör en fruktansvärd upptäckt hos en av sina hyresgäster. I lägenhetens badkar ligger resterna av en förruttnad kropp. Kan polisen verkligen hinna ikapp förövarna?

programme.title: Norska Fall: Avsnitt 204
programme.desc: En kväll 2012 går larmet i 98-åriga Hilda Festes hem. När hemtjänstpersonalen anländer bevittnar de något fruktansvärt. Polisen börjar genast att leta efter hennes angripare.

programme.title: Svenska fall: Avsnitt 1301
programme.desc: Den 2 augusti 2020 skjuts den 12-åriga flickan Adriana till döds utanför ett McDonalds i södra Stockholm. Efteråt inleds en intensiv polisjakt för att hitta mördarna som sköt ihjäl ett oskyldigt barn.

programme.title: Norska Fall: Avsnitt 304
programme.desc: I augusti 2004 stormade två beväpnade personer in på Munchmuseet på Tøyen. I kaoset som uppstår tar de med sig de två världsberömda målningarna Scream och Madonna. Nu påbörjas en intensiv polisjakt.

programme.title: Efterlyst

programme.title: Efterlyst
programme.desc: En sällsynt stor våg av inbrott på byggarbetsplatser har drabbat de östra delarna av Svealand sedan början av februari. Efterlyst uppmärksammar att det på lördag är 40 år sedan mordet på Olof Palme.

programme.title: Efterlyst
programme.desc: Efterlyst tar denna vecka upp en äldrebedragare på Lidingö som fångats på övervakningskamera, en våldsam mordbrand mot en frisörsalong och stölder på J Lindebergs och Peak Performances lagerlokaler.

programme.title: Efterlyst
programme.desc: Kopparstölder sker mitt framför allmänhetens ögon i Göteborg, och nya spår efter mordet på 19-åriga William har kommit fram. Vi får även höra om hjältedåden som är nominerade till Civilkuragepriset.

programme.title: Efterlyst

programme.title: Klovn: Kram Och Mugg

programme.title: Klovn: Amatörerna

programme.title: Klovn: Falskt Skit Alarm

programme.title: Klovn: Det Muslimska Pianot
programme.desc: Frank och Mia ska köpa ett begagnat piano. När Frank får reda på att säljaren är muslim tar han över förhandlingarna. Sådana saker kräver en man.

programme.title: Klovn: Baked Alaska

programme.title: Klovn: #metoo

programme.title: Klovn: Gottegrisen
programme.desc: Man är missnöjd i området med den obehagliga, men duktiga slaktaren Lund. Så när Frank får en ”tjänst till godo” i den kriminella världen beslutar han sig för att lära slaktare Lund en läxa.

programme.title: Klovn: Tipo Napoli
programme.desc: Frank får den sorgliga nyheten att en god vän är död. Det handlar om en förfärlig frysboxolycka. När Frank får reda på att frysboxen senare är till salu blir han otroligt arg och beslutar sig för att själv rätta till saken.

programme.title: Klovn: Känner Du Till Typen?

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model
programme.desc: The girls arrive at Models 1, where they meet Mark Evans along with casting agents. They take a Polaroid shot for a casting. Mark announces that they will be going to Rio de Janeiro, Brazil, but there are only four places on the plane.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model
programme.desc: The girls arrive in Rio and excitedly explore the luxurious villa they will be staying in. On a rare day off, they are driven to Ipanema to play beach volleyball with local guys, and in the evening, they are joined for dinner by Lisa.

programme.title: Lyxfällan Norge: Avsnitt 2403

programme.title: Lyxfällan Norge: Avsnitt 2404

programme.title: Lyxfällan Norge: Avsnitt 2405

programme.title: Lyxfällan Norge: Avsnitt 2406

programme.title: Lyxfällan Norge: Avsnitt 2407

programme.title: Lyxfällan Norge: Avsnitt 2501

programme.title: Star Trek: The Original Series
programme.desc: Kirk beams down on a diplomatic mission. He finds himself on an Enterprise where all the crew has vanished, and only a mysterious woman resides.

programme.title: Star Trek: The Original Series
programme.desc: Kirk, McCoy, and Sulu are stranded on a barren planet where a mysterious woman attempts to kill them one at a time, while the Enterprise must travel halfway across the galaxy to rescue them.

programme.title: Forensic Files: In the Bag
programme.desc: After shooting his victims in the head, the killer staged the scene, placed the incriminating evidence into a plastic bag and tossed it into the river.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Yes, In Deed
programme.desc: It was a tragic twist of fate. Just days after a woman sold her home and moved to a modest trailer, a fire took both the trailer and her life. But the autopsy proved this was no accident.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Guarded Secrets
programme.desc: A security guard disappeared from his post without a trace; his remains were found a year later in a remote campsite.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Smoking Out a Killer
programme.desc: A college senior was found raped and murdered near an unpaved footpath used by students to walk from one side of campus to the other.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Frozen Assets
programme.desc: In 2004, Mary Ann Clibbery was found brutally murdered at her Illinois business. Investigators had to determine if this was a robbery gone wrong or a calculated murder.

programme.title: Forensic Files: House Hunting
programme.desc: In 2006, Texas real estate agent Sarah Anne Walker was found brutally murdered in a model home. Weeks later, a witness came forward who may have seen the killer. Police used forensic hypnosis to help him recall every detail of the man's appearance.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Shoot to Thrill
programme.desc: In 2003, St. Cloud teenager Jason MacLennan returned home after a night out with friends and discovered his father's body lying in a pool of blood.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Political Thriller
programme.desc: In 2006, Nevada politician Kathy Augustine died mysteriously during a re-election campaign. The medical examiner could neither isolate the cause of death, nor explain the tiny puncture wounds discovered during the autopsy.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Double Cross
programme.desc: In 1996, Virginia Beach police arrive at the Makdessi apartment to find the bloodied bodies of Elise Makdessi and Navy sailor Quincy Brown. But was Brown Elise's lover or her assailant?

programme.title: Forensic Files: Dancing with the Devil
programme.desc: In 1999, Patrick McRae was found dead in his Des Moines home and the crime scene was awash with blood. Analysis showed it had come from two people, one of whom was female.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Last Dance
programme.desc: In 2000, the body of exotic dancer Rachel Siani was found beneath a New Jersey bridge. Investigators wondered if she had committed suicide. They discovered that Rachel offered to assist a drunk customer named John "Jack" Denofa to his motel room.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Killing Spree
programme.desc: In 1984, in South Florida, a rapist and murderer was on the loose. The killer was a ruthless and terrifying predator, the newest member of an infamous group known as serial killers.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Melissa Brannen: Missing
programme.desc: In 1989, residents of a close-knit apartment community in Virginia gathered for a holiday celebration. For Tammy Brannen and five-year-old daughter Melissa, Christmas was always a special time. Then without warning, the little girl was gone.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Unabomber
programme.desc: For nearly two decades a mathematical genius with delusions of single-handedly destroying industrial society, planted or mailed powerful bombs to unsuspecting innocent victims.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Murdering Cowboy
programme.desc: The sun set on the Wild West long ago, but some people refused to notice. Claude Dallas was one of them. A wily trapper, Dallas typified the rugged individualism that forged this country. He went too far when he killed two game wardens in 1981.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The World Trade Center Bombing
programme.desc: Terrorist bombings are what happen in other countries. Not here in the United States. And yet, in 1993, it happened in New York City.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Bad Medicine
programme.desc: Drug trafficking has spawned a violent and deadly criminal underground. It's providing a challenge to forensic investigators devoted to cracking drug rings.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Stranger Than Fiction
programme.desc: A millionaire is found dead, murdered for a stash of buried silver. A young woman dates violent men, only to be killed by her best friend.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Soldier Stories
programme.desc: This show profiles the work of world-renowned forensic experts as they work to tell the stories of the young men who went to war (from the French and Indian war to Vietnam) and never came back.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Drawing Conclusions
programme.desc: A teenager is abducted on a shopping trip. Two hikers disappear from the Appalachian Trail.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Price of Murder
programme.desc: Using science as their most powerful weapon, investigators must find these hired killers and make them pay the true price of murder.

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: Is My Husband the Abuser?
programme.desc: Joyia is desperate to keep her friend Stephanie from going back to her problematic ex Scott. But she still loves him! Will she have the strength to leave him?

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: My Wife Beats Our Babies
programme.desc: Jack is worried about his grandchildren because his daughter-in-law Carol has been negligent and hot-tempered. Then, Kendra explains why she suddenly put Corey’s baby up for adoption.

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: Did You Murder My Daughter?
programme.desc: Teenager Megan lives with her older controlling boyfriend Rick. Megan cannot attend school, find a job, or even eat without his OK! Can her aunt and Steve get through to her?

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: Did You Fake Your Pregnancies?
programme.desc: Dennis claims his ex-girlfriend Kendal keeps tied down with pregnancy lies! He wants to know if their daughter is even his! Will Steve’s DNA test results finally let them move on?

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: Results Revealed: Did She Cheat?
programme.desc: Justin is convinced that girlfriend Lainie has been cheating on him, and more importantly that he’s not the father of their child. But his own insecurities have led him to turn violent. Also, Steven doubts whether Ashley’s child is his.

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: A Tragic Accident
programme.desc: Rebecca left her baby with fiancé James and his mother Adeline, only to discover that her baby was hospitalized. Rebecca suspects that James is responsible. Adeline blames her for the baby’s death!

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Eyes of a Child
programme.desc: A loving, churchgoing grandmother is found stabbed to death in her apartment, leaving Joe Kenda to wonder what sort of monster could do such a thing.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Make My Day

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: The Shoelace Killer
programme.desc: A party on the outskirts of the city turns into a nightmare for some teenagers when they discover a woman’s corpse.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Worst I’ve Ever Seen
programme.desc: Two grandparents are shot to death in their family home. Kenda’s investigation kicks into high gear when his prime suspect flees for the Mexican border.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: 12 Years a Fugitive
programme.desc: When a beloved grandmother is found stabbed to death in her own home, Kenda must turn to a tight-knit community still grieving from the tragic loss.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: New Year's Evil
programme.desc: It’s New Year’s Eve weekend, and in the midst of the revelry Miguel Mendez is beaten to death outside a convenience store. Lt. Joe Kenda faces a challenging investigation.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Make My Day
programme.desc: When Keith Andrews is killed, a man steps forward claiming he did it in self-defense—but Lt. Joe Kenda has his doubts.

programme.title: 72 Hours: Hunted

programme.title: 72 Hours: Predator
programme.desc: The phone rings in the middle of the night. On the other end of the line, the sounds of an attack. The couple that receive the call rush to its source and discover a horrific scene.

programme.title: 72 Hours: Evil Eyes
programme.desc: A dead woman is found in a park. It’s learned the deceased is a divorced landlady of a group home for transients. The suspect list is long; the clues to follow are few.

programme.title: 72 Hours: Lust
programme.desc: One morning in the stairwell of a Toronto building, a guard makes a grotesque discovery: the dead body of a Filipina nanny. It's clear she's been savagely murdered and raped.

programme.title: 72 Hours: Model Killer
programme.desc: A gorgeous young model is bludgeoned to death in her downtown apartment. The wounds to her head are so severe police initially presume she's been shot.

programme.title: 72 Hours: Dead End
programme.desc: A young couple hits the road, hitchhiking across North America. Free spirits keen to explore the world. When the young woman stops phoning home, her father is alarmed.

programme.title: iCarly: Skoskav
programme.desc: Carly, Sam och Freddie blir inbjudna till Dakas huvudkontor, där de blir erbjudna en stor summa pengar för att rekommendera Dakas nya sko, Tech-Foot, på iCarly. Men skon visar sig vara fruktansvärd.

programme.title: iCarly: Jag lovar att inte berätta
programme.desc: Carly får betyget B på en historieuppsats hon borde ha fått ett A på. Sam ser sin chans under sitt veckomöte med rektor Franklin, och ändrar Carlys betyg i datorn och överraskar henne med flera A.

programme.title: iCarly: iCarly räddar TV
programme.desc: En höjdar-producent vill förvandla iCarly till en TV-show. Men Carly, Sam och Freddie blir snabbt upprörda när de får höra talas om alla de stora ändringar som TV-producenten vill göra.

programme.title: iCarly: Jag hatar Sams pojkvän
programme.desc: Sam skaffar pojkvän, och de båda är oskiljaktiga. Men när förhållandet börjar påverka iCarly, inser Carly och Freddie att de måste göra något åt det.

programme.title: iCarly: Övervakning
programme.desc: Efter att ha sett ett inslag på iCarly som visade en man som säljer olagliga filmkopior, bestämmer sig två poliser för att använda Carlys och Spencers våning som en övervakningsplats.

programme.title: iCarly: Jag kanske byter skola
programme.desc: Carly får veta att hon på grund av sin webbshow, kan få möjlighet till ett heltäckande stipendium till den privata elitskolan Briarwood. Carly är inte så sugen på det, men Sam och Freddie vet att de måste få henne att ändra sig.

programme.title: iCarly: Fart och fäkt
programme.desc: Freddie behöver spendera tid med bara killar, så han följer med Spencer på fäktning. Freddie är en naturbegåvning, men saker och ting blir komplicerade när Spencer får honom involverad i en match mot den fantastiske Doug Toder.

programme.title: iCarly: Vinn en dejt
programme.desc: När deras vän Gibby är för blyg för att bjuda ut en tjej han gillar, bestämmer sig gänget för att göra honom och föremålet för hans kärlek till tävlande i ett "Vinn en dejt"-inslag i sin webbshow.

programme.title: iCarly: Jag såg honom först
programme.desc: När Carly och Sam blir intresserade av samma kille, lovar de att det inte ska komma emellan deras vänskap. Det här visar sig bli svårare än de trott och snart prövas deras vänskap medan de håller på och tävlar om hans uppmärksamhet.

programme.title: iCarly: Beroendeframkallande
programme.desc: Carly måste ingripa när Spencer blir spelberoende. Sam lurar Freddie att tro att han har drabbats av otur bara för att han vägrade skicka vidare ett kedje-email.

programme.title: The Drew Barrymore Show: Kate Mara, Molly Sims, Holiday Food Traditions with Eitan
programme.desc: "A Teacher" star Kate Mara stops by to chat. Model and actress Molly Sims on the inspiration behind her lifestyle website. TikTok star and culinary contributor Eitan Bernath shares the history behind some of your favorite holiday treats

programme.title: 48 Hours
programme.desc: In 1994, 25-year-old Toni Dykstra of Los Angeles, the single mother of two young daughters, met and married Carlo Ventre, a successful 46-year-old Italian businessman. After Toni gave birth to their child, Santina, the couple's relationship soured.

programme.title: 48 Hours: Secrets From The Grave
programme.desc: Bill Flint spent his life cheating death -- not once, not twice, but three times. His friends say this is a story of how a lot of bad things happened to a really good person.

programme.title: 48 Hours: Black Dahlia Confidential
programme.desc: The brutal murder in 1947 of Elizabeth Short, a young, struggling actress whose body was discovered in a vacant lot in January 1947, has baffled the Los Angeles Police Department for decades

programme.title: 48 Hours: Blaming the Babysitter
programme.desc: A frantic 13-year-old, Ashley Howes, calls 911 because the toddler she's babysitting won't wake up. Prosecutors are convinced Ashley Howes shook 19-month-old Freya Garden to death. They charge Howes with second degree murder.

programme.title: 48 Hours: The Informer

programme.title: COPS: Running in Traffic

programme.title: COPS: Taser Proof
programme.desc: A man gets Tased while resisting arrest, police interrupt a transaction going down in a parked vehicle, and a man fired from his job vents his anger at a gas station.

programme.title: COPS: You'll Shoot Your Eye Out
programme.desc: A mom takes sides when a battle breaks out between brothers, and a man is accused of targeting children with a BB gun.

programme.title: COPS: I'll Raise My Voice Right Back!

programme.title: COPS: We Know Who You Are

programme.title: Star Trek: The Original Series
programme.desc: Kirk, McCoy, and Sulu are stranded on a barren planet where a mysterious woman attempts to kill them one at a time, while the Enterprise must travel halfway across the galaxy to rescue them.

programme.title: Star Trek: The Original Series
programme.desc: The Enterprise must deal with incorporeal cloud-like aliens who have already destroyed the inhabitants of a library planet.

programme.title: Star Trek: The Original Series
programme.desc: While seeking a cure for a fever ravaging the Enterprise, Kirk and Spock encounter Flint, a hermit-like Earthman, and his beautiful young ward.

programme.title: Star Trek: The Original Series
programme.desc: The Enterprise picks up a group of space "hippies" looking for Eden.

programme.title: Star Trek: The Original Series
programme.desc: To acquire the resources to cure a space plague, Kirk must resolve a mining dispute between the cultural elites of the cloud city of Stratos and the miners on the surface.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Last Dance
programme.desc: In 2000, the body of exotic dancer Rachel Siani was found beneath a New Jersey bridge. Investigators wondered if she had committed suicide. They discovered that Rachel offered to assist a drunk customer named John "Jack" Denofa to his motel room.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Constructive Criticism
programme.desc: In 2000, construction manager Darrell North was found dead in his work trailer in Ft. Worth, Texas. When investigators arrived, they found that he had been stabbed 46 times, indicating a personal relationship between the victim and the attacker.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Home Evasion
programme.desc: In 2000, Judy Southern arrived home from work and was shot by a gunman waiting within. Her husband arrived shortly afterwards, called emergency services and drove her to the hospital.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Window Watcher
programme.desc: In 1986, Gary Dale Larson was stabbed to death in his Edmond, Oklahoma home. The killer then sexually assaulted Larson's girlfriend, Janet Haynes.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Stranger in the Night
programme.desc: In 1991, Dorothy Donovan was murdered in her Dover, Delaware home. When her son stated that she was murdered by a hitchhiker he had picked up, police were skeptical.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Kidnapping
programme.desc: In 2001, Ginger Hayes and her infant son were abducted during a carjacking. The crime had been reported by a witness within minutes of occurrence.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Sands of Crime
programme.desc: In the early hours of a morning just before Christmas, a college student was abducted from the parking lot of her apartment. Her body was found later that day; she had been sexually assaulted and shot at point-blank range.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Calculated Coincidence
programme.desc: A young woman is found dead in her apartment. With little evidence at the scene, the case turns cold — until police discover a link between their prime suspect and an unsolved murder committed six years earlier in a different state.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Sworded Scheme
programme.desc: When a college student is reported missing, police believe their investigation will be like countless others. But when they discover blood spatter in her boyfriend's bedroom, they know this case is going to be different.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Unmasked
programme.desc: A serial rapist is on the loose in a Texas town. No one knew where he'd strike next, but the audacity of his attacks and the escalation of violence against his victims made finding him imperative.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Fashion Police
programme.desc: The victim had been stabbed more than thirty times and the crime scene was awash with her blood. Near her head, police discovered a distinctive button with strands of thread still attached.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The World Trade Center Bombing
programme.desc: Terrorist bombings are what happen in other countries. Not here in the United States. And yet, in 1993, it happened in New York City.

programme.title: The FBI Files: John Gotti: Convicted
programme.desc: John Gotti was ambitious, powerful and ruthless. He ruled with flash and conspicuous style, playing celebrity with the media and cat and mouse with the FBI. They called John Gotti the Teflon Don. Serious charges just wouldn't stick.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The True Story of Mississippi Burning
programme.desc: Philadelphia, Mississippi, 1964. A sleepy southern town steeped in tradition finds itself targeted for invasion.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Polly Klaas: Kidnapped
programme.desc: On October 1, 1993, a stranger abducted 12-year-old Polly Klaas during a slumber party in her home.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Above the Law
programme.desc: California Highway Patrolman George Gwaltney discovered the body of 23-year-old Robin Bishop near her car on a remote desert highway.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Price of Murder
programme.desc: Using science as their most powerful weapon, investigators must find these hired killers and make them pay the true price of murder.

programme.title: The New Detectives: A Taste of Poison
programme.desc: Poisoners are the most devious of killers, relying on stealth or their victim's trust in order to steal their lives. They're the most dangerous creatures in the world: smart assassins. And they usually don't stop at one kill.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Proof Of Innocence
programme.desc: DNA analysis overturns the convictions of three men who have spent years behind bars, paying for crimes they did not commit.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Patterns Of Guilt
programme.desc: The tread of a tire, a single shoe print and even the shape of a bruise help investigators track down killers, based solely on their patterns of guilt.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Crimes Of Passion
programme.desc: When killers are driven by jealousy and desire, their desperation is evident in both the crime and their efforts to avoid detection. But forensic science can reveal even the slightest mistake to solve crimes of passion.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Coroner Investigator
programme.desc: CI: Coroner Investigator will reveal the most in-depth look to date into the science of death.

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: A Tragic Accident
programme.desc: Rebecca left her baby with fiancé James and his mother Adeline, only to discover that her baby was hospitalized. Rebecca suspects that James is responsible. Adeline blames her for the baby’s death!

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: I’m Starving Myself to Death
programme.desc: Pamela aims to weigh 40 pounds. Samantha, who suffers from bulimia and alcoholism, steals to accomplish her binging. Can both women confront their eating disorders with support and treatment?

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: Crawl to Your Wife
programme.desc: After surviving a wild car chase, losing her leg, and being comatose due to her husband, Portia will finally confront him. He won't admit fault, but today Steve’s helping Portia find her voice.

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: My Teen Daughter Wants a Baby
programme.desc: 17-year-old Naomi has undergone a sudden attitude change and is on a mission to have a baby. Parents Leeanders and April need Steve to intervene!

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: You Stole 15 Years of My Life
programme.desc: Jennifer left home to protect herself from her stepdad Allen. 15 years later, her mother wants a second chance, but Jennifer is hesitant. Can Steve help mend this broken family?

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: She Is My Property
programme.desc: Lanikka is sick and tired of her boyfriend Malcom’s abusive ways. Then, Tim’s jealousy has torn his family apart, but now he’s desperate to win them back, but will Tiffany leave him for good?

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: You Slept With THAT Man?
programme.desc: LaShawna and her boyfriend James will learn if her friend Coral harmed her child years ago. She’ll also admit that she cheated with Coral. How will he react when he finds out another bombshell?

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: 12 Years a Fugitive
programme.desc: When a beloved grandmother is found stabbed to death in her own home, Kenda must turn to a tight-knit community still grieving from the tragic loss.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Murder Bites
programme.desc: A young woman is found naked and strangled in a park not 200 yards from her home. It isn’t until Lt. Joe Kenda rethinks the entire case that he realizes someone has been lying.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Winter’s Bone
programme.desc: High in the mountains above Colorado Springs, a woman’s frozen body is found along a switchback road. Investigators need to figure out what brought her here in the first place.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: #1 Suspect
programme.desc: Lt. Joe Kenda must somehow solve a stranger-on-stranger crime with just a composite sketch of the killer and a mysterious bouquet of flowers.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Bad Things Come in Threes
programme.desc: When two young mothers are gunned down behind a crowded bar, Kenda has to first determine who was the intended target and who was collateral damage.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Lockdown
programme.desc: When a crazed gunman terrorizes his neighborhood, officers put themselves in the line of fire to restore order.

programme.title: 72 Hours: Dead End

programme.title: 72 Hours: Bull's Eye

programme.title: Dr. G: Medical Examiner

programme.title: Dr. G: Medical Examiner
programme.desc: It’s an early Sunday morning when a local resident decides to take a shortcut through the church parking lot. Walking past a lone car, the resident can’t believe his eyes.

programme.title: Dr. G: Medical Examiner

programme.title: Dr. G: Medical Examiner

programme.desc: Sam blir förolämpad när Freddie anklagar henne för att inte betala tillbaka pengarna hon ständigt lånar av honom och Carly. Sam försöker allt hon kan komma på för att kunna betala tillbaka; till och med ett riktigt jobb.

programme.title: iCarly: Aj, Lewbert
programme.desc: En "Driva med Lewbert"-sketch går förskräckligt fel och skadar Carlys oförskämde portvakt. Gänget vårdar honom tills dess att Freddies mamma kommer in och tar över. När en romans börjar spira måste de sätta stopp för den.

programme.title: iCarly: Pajen

programme.title: iCarly: Kyssen
programme.desc: Sam råkar höra när Freddie erkänner för Carly att han aldrig har kysst en tjej , och avslöjar sedan hans hemlighet på webbshowen. Gibby och Carly tränar Spencer inför uttagningen till det lokala proffs-fotbollslaget.

programme.title: iCarly: Vinn en bil

programme.title: iCarly: Sluta Fred

programme.title: iCarly: Dubbelgångare
programme.desc: När Carly, Sam och Freddie smiter ut för att se en kampsport-match, skaffar de dubbelgångare för att lura Spencer att de fortfarande är hemma. Under tiden bygger Spencer en gigantisk version av Newtons vagga.

programme.title: iCarly: Rockidolen
programme.desc: När Carly, Sam och Freddie uppmanar iCarly-fansen att rösta för att David Archuleta ska ta hem segern i "America Sings", tycker de synd om tvåan och hjälper honom göra en musikvideo. Under tiden lär Sam Spencer hur man ljuger som ett proffs.

programme.desc: Author and former EIC of Teen Vogue Elaine Welteroth on joining "The Talk," the 15 Percent Pledge and more. "The Prom's" Andrew Rannells chats. Drew has a big surprise for a college student making and selling jewelry to raise money for Feeding America.

programme.title: 48 Hours: The Informer
programme.desc: A report on the moral dilemma faced by Jim Morel, a Massachusetts musician, who was told by another musician friend, Jason Weir, that the 2001 death of Marina Calabro, the aunt of their bandmate Anthony Calabro, though ruled an accident, was murder.

programme.title: 48 Hours: Deadly Proposal
programme.desc: Stephanie Pepper Sims was a college professor in the prime of her life when she suddenly vanished without a trace. Estranged from her husband, Stephanie moved in with a lover. Eventually, a hand-drawn map would lead investigators her body.

programme.title: 48 Hours: Duty, Death, Dishonor
programme.desc: 25-year-old U.S. Army Specialist Richard Davis took part in the March 2003 invasion of Iraq. After celebrating his homecoming with four Army buddies, he disappeared and was listed by the Army as AWOL. A tip led to the discovery of his body.

programme.title: 48 Hours: Deadly Ride
programme.desc: Jane Mixer, a student at the University of Michigan Law School in March of 1969, had just agreed to get married and had arranged a ride home to tell her parents. Her body was found in a small, rural cemetery just miles from her dorm.

programme.title: 48 Hours: Nightmare in Napa
programme.desc: A report on the October 2004 murders of former beauty queen Leslie Mazzara and her roommate, Adriane Insogna, in the bedrooms of their Napa, California home. A third roommate, Lauren Mianza, sleeping downstairs, was not harmed and was the only witness

programme.title: 48 Hours: Jeffrey MacDonald: Fight for Truth
programme.desc: A report on the 1970 murders of U.S. Army Doctor Jeffrey MacDonald’s pregnant wife and two daughters at their Fort Bragg home. Having served 25 years in prison for the murders, MacDonald still proclaims his innocence.

programme.title: COPS: Sucker Punch

programme.desc: A motorcyclist wanted by police hides out in his mom's garage, a man won't leave his ex-fiancee alone, and a pregnant woman gets busted for meth possession.

programme.title: COPS: Turbo Charged
programme.desc: An officer on street patrol chases down a suspect on foot, an alleged car thief posts his exploits on Facebook, and a crashed stolen car may not have been stolen after all.

programme.title: COPS: Pass the Rock

programme.title: COPS: Not My Crack
programme.desc: An officer pursues an unruly bicyclist, a man ducks into a drive-through in an attempt to elude police, and a deputy pulls over a stolen vehicle driven by a repeat offender.

programme.desc: A resistant suspect thinks he sees monsters everywhere. Cops are forced to officiate a spousal wrestling match. Officers try to sort out where two motorists got their car and whose dope they possess.

programme.desc: A wild-eyed man leads police on a chase that ends in a Tasing, officers respond to an in-progress lovers' spat, and a traffic stop results in drug and auto theft charges.

programme.title: Lyxfällan: Avsnitt 2406

programme.title: Lyxfällan

programme.title: Lyxfällan: Avsnitt 2610

programme.title: Unga Mammor: Avsnitt 607

programme.title: Unga Mammor: Avsnitt 608
programme.desc: Natalie försöker få Cornelia att sluta amma. Ellinor berättar om relationen med Jimmy, och han förbereder en överraskning till henne för att ge henne uppskattning. Sonia tar med barnen ut på parklek.

programme.title: Unga Mammor: Avsnitt 609
programme.desc: Izabell berättar om att hon mötte sin fästman på grund av att han var storebror till hennes bästa kompis. Fayme är och badar med Leo. Luma och barnen fixar fint i trädgården.

programme.title: Unga Mammor: Avsnitt 610
programme.desc: Ellinor går med sonen Aaron på event och berättar om hur hon fått kämpa under uppväxten för att få leva det liv hon gör idag. Sonia lär Daisy att cykla och Natalie inreder lekstugan.

programme.title: Unga Mammor: Avsnitt 611
programme.desc: Izabell är gravid och låter sonen Domeniq avslöja hennes graviditet för fästmannen. Fayme tar med barnen på second hand, och Luma vill att barnen ska börja sporta och tar med dem på tennis.

programme.title: Unga Mammor: Avsnitt 612
programme.desc: Sonia berättar om när hon blev gravid och om skadorna hon fick under första förlossningen. Natalie lär Richard att rida på deras häst, och Ellinor och Jimmy försöker få vardagen att gå ihop.

programme.title: Unga Mammor: Avsnitt 613
programme.desc: Luma åker med familjen till Istanbul för att operera näsan. Izabell berättar om hennes morfar som satt 30 år i finskt fängelse. Fayme och Moltas firar fyraårig bröllopsdag och drar iväg utan barnen.

programme.title: Unga Mammor: Avsnitt 614
programme.desc: Ellinor har haft astma hela hennes liv men trotsar den för att testa en ny typ av träningsform. Sonia går på treårskontroll, har kalas för Lily och reflekterar över hur underbart det är att ge liv.

programme.title: Unga Mammor: Avsnitt 615
programme.desc: Luma vaknar upp efter näsoperationen och blir förälskad i sin nya näsa, frågan är vad familjen kommer tycka? Izabell tar med Domeniq för ettårsvaccination.

programme.title: Unga Mammor: Avsnitt 616
programme.desc: Natalies stress har blivit allvarligare. Det är dags att varva ned och hon tar med familjen på spa. Aaron ska döpas och Ellinor är nervös då hon känner att hon inte har full koll.

programme.title: Frusna vägar: Avsnitt 205

programme.title: Frusna vägar: Avsnitt 206

programme.title: Frusna vägar: Avsnitt 207
programme.desc: En långtradare har vält utanför Umeå, en svår utmaning även för erfarna bärgare. Mogge får rycka ut och hjälpa en fullastad sopbil som har fått problem. Robin i Järpen får vara kreativ när han ska hjälpa en husbilsägare som sitter illa till.

programme.title: Frusna vägar: Avsnitt 208

programme.title: Frusna vägar

programme.title: Svenska Hollywoodfruar: Avsnitt 1001

programme.title: Forensic Files: Drowning Sorrows
programme.desc: A family vacation turns into a nightmare when a woman is found face-down in a lake.

programme.title: Forensic Files: As Fault
programme.desc: Witnesses saw a woman in the back of a truck, flailing her arms and screaming. When they found a jacket near a pool of blood, they knew what they had seen wasn't a joy ride.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Family Ties
programme.desc: When court clerk Peter Porco doesn't report to work in November 2004, a courts officer is ordered to the Porcos' family home in Bethlehem, NY.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Trouble Brewing
programme.desc: Two suspects are linked to a murder by bloodstained boots and a gun, but the owner of the items says he has never met the victim. Investigators hope manufacturing codes from beer bottles will determine who is telling the truth.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Holy Terror
programme.desc: This episode documents a deadly bombing at a church in Oakwood, Illinois, in December 1997.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Above the Law

programme.title: The FBI Files: Human Prey
programme.desc: Thomas Dillon killed five outdoorsmen at random over a period of three years in rural southern Ohio. After a tip led the FBI to the murder weapon, ballistic testing made a match.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Death in Alaska
programme.desc: The day began like any other for Cheryl and Paul Chapman, until the silence of a peaceful Sunday morning was shattered with a phone call.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Paradise
programme.desc: It should have been Shangri-La, but when bad blood developed, piracy took over and the only law was the law of the jungle.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Crazy Don
programme.desc: To the FBI, he was believed to be the boss of New York's most powerful mafia organizationthe Genovese crime family. Was Gigante crazy or was his behavior a shrewd attempt to disguise his position as a ruthless mafia boss?

programme.title: The New Detectives: Coroner Investigator
programme.desc: CI: Coroner Investigator will reveal the most in-depth look to date into the science of death.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Trial By Fire
programme.desc: At a crime scene, anything left behind or seemingly out of place is considered a clue. But a fire can extinguish everything in its path challenging forensic investigators at every turn and making each arson a trial by fire.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Stolen Youths
programme.desc: A young girl playing in her yard in Spokane, Washington suddenly vanishes. In St. Louis, another girl leaves to visit a friend. She never arrived.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Partners In Crime
programme.desc: They say that a burden shared is a burden halved, but when partners team up to commit murder, the weight of their guilt remains just as heavy. Investigators must rely on forensic science to capture partners in crime.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Cold Cases
programme.desc: These cases took a decade or more to solve. There's no statute of limitations on murder. As a case turns cold, the clues become scarce, investigators must rely on science to close cold cases.

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: You Slept With THAT Man?
programme.desc: LaShawna and her boyfriend James will learn if her friend Coral harmed her child years ago. She’ll also admit that she cheated with Coral. How will he react when he finds out another bombshell?

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: You Better Not Fail That Test!
programme.desc: Lainie and Justin have a 9-month-old baby together. Justin hurts Lainie because he thinks she’s cheating. But how will Steve react when he confronts Justin?

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: How Could You Cover for Him?
programme.desc: Gina believes that her daughter’s boyfriend Efrain is abusing her grandson. Her daughter wants to prove that Efrain is innocent, but her father Raul suspects she is covering for Efrain.

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: Who Did This?
programme.desc: Who’s responsible for toddler Noel's well-being? Everyone may deny the allegations, but someone knows what happened, and Steve is getting answers!

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: My Boyfriend Beat Up My Mom
programme.desc: Kendra is on a mission to save herself from her toxic boyfriend Chris. At 17, Kendra is pregnant with his sixth child. Kendra has tried almost everything including kicking him out of their house, but he not only argued back but assaulted Kendra as well.

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: Steve Over the Edge
programme.desc: Sheroya is 17 and struggling to raise 2 kids while trying to party all the time. Her boyfriend Malcolm frequently cheats and verbally abuses her. Steve’s got a lot of work ahead with this couple, but will either of them wake up?

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Lockdown
programme.desc: When a crazed gunman terrorizes his neighborhood, officers put themselves in the line of fire to restore order.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Last Fare
programme.desc: A young man is found dead behind the wheel of his taxi. With robbery seeming unlikely, Kenda and Gaenzle wonder if this was personal.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Sing Sing, Little Bird
programme.desc: A romantic rendezvous is cut short by a violent home invasion, leaving young business owner Kelly Knudson bleeding to death on the floor and Lt Joe Kenda is short on leads.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Powder Kegs
programme.desc: When uninvited guests crash a barrio birthday party, violence erupts—leaving Enrique Urrutia dead and potentially sparking a gang war.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Human Animal
programme.desc: The naked body of a vibrant young mother is found frozen solid in a deserted cemetery. Kenda reopens the investigation and recognizes the sinister hallmark of a serial killer.

programme.title: Dr. G: Medical Examiner

programme.title: Evil Twins: Deadly Doppelgangers

programme.title: Evil Twins: The Candymen

programme.title: Evil Twins: Folie Aux Deux

programme.title: Evil Twins: Do No Harm

programme.title: On the Case: Courage and Conviction

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Crash Landing

programme.title: The Drew Barrymore Show: Best of Digital with Andy Cohen, Gayle King, Sean Evans, "50 First Dates" Reunion Sketch
programme.desc: Drew's best of digital hour! Drew’s sit-downs with "Watch What Happens Live" Host Andy Cohen, "CBS This Morning" Co-Host Gayle King and "Hot Ones" host Sean Evans. Plus, a look at how our "50 First Dates" reunion sketch with Adam Sandler came together.

programme.title: The Drew Barrymore Show: Craig Ferguson, The Bella Twins, #GrandGoals, Cooking with Chef Pilar Valdes

programme.title: 48 Hours: Jeffrey MacDonald: Fight for Truth

programme.title: 48 Hours: A Shot in the Dark
programme.desc: Dr. Richard Illes, a heart surgeon, and his wife, Miriam, were a prominent couple in Williamsport, PA. Then, on Jan. 15, 1999, Miriam was fatally shot as she stood in front of her kitchen window. Investigators think that Richard was responsible.

programme.title: 48 Hours: Secrets & Lies on Grapevine Lake

programme.title: 48 Hours

programme.title: 48 Hours
programme.desc: A report on events surrounding the mysterious death of aspiring actress Ashley Barnett on the cruise ship "Paradise" in October 2005.

programme.desc: En ung kvinna verkar vara den enda överlevaren efter ett kärnvapenkrig, och hon lever på egen hand, helt utan någon omkring sig. Men en dag får hon syn på den största överraskningen i sitt liv: en annan människa.

programme.title: In the Name of Ben-Hur
programme.desc: A young gladiator enslaved in the Roman arena in 171 A.D. escapes by chariot towards the freedom of Hadrian's Wall. Fighting centurions and mercenaries along the way, he becomes a folk hero for all those struggling to fight Roman oppression.

programme.title: Cold Zone
programme.desc: En storm är på väg. Ingen kan förutsäga den. Ingen kan mäta dess storlek. Nu måste en familj överleva den. Och ingen kan söka skydd från stormen, ingen kommer in från kylan...

programme.title: Meet the Spartans

programme.title: A Haunted House

programme.title: Death at a Funeral

programme.title: Being Mary Jane: Sleepless In Atlanta

programme.title: Klovn: Fars Sista Önskan

programme.title: Klovn: Storlek 44

programme.title: Klovn: Årstiderne

programme.title: Klovn: Farväl Igen, Mamma!
programme.desc: Frank ska på herrlunch, men måste först flytta sin mammas urna till en annan plats på kyrkogården. Han förolämpar grävaren, vilket får konsekvenser.

programme.title: Klovn: Casa Tua
programme.desc: Mia vill att Frank ska kolla sin sperma vilket får följder. Casper tror inte att Frank skulle lägga ett graviditetstest med Mias kiss på köksbordet; vem är skyldig?

programme.title: Key & Peele: Obama Shutdown

programme.title: Key & Peele: The Branding

programme.title: Key & Peele: Les Miz

programme.title: Key & Peele: Severed Head Showcase

programme.title: Key & Peele: Biological Dad

programme.title: The FBI Files

programme.title: The FBI Files
